description: Semantic (meaning-based) search over the Handsontable + HyperFormula documentation knowledge base — docs guides, code recipes, blog posts, release notes and GitHub issues. Returns ranked page-level snippets with title, content, relevance score, url and provenance (framework, kind, htVersion/hfVersion). `url` is null when no public page exists (recipes, releases, issues) — never fabricate a link. Scores are rank-only. Guides repeat once per framework (javascript/react/angular/vue) — dedupe on url/title when you need distinct documents. Pass ht_version/hf_version (your installed releases) to get an explicit coverage note when the KB documents a different version.

hf_version.description: Your installed HyperFormula version (e.g. "3.4.0") — same coverage-note semantics.

ht_version.description: Your installed Handsontable version (e.g. "18.1.0") — adds an explicit coverage note when the KB documents a different minor.

query.description: Search terms or a natural-language question.

name: search_docs
title: Search Handsontable/HyperFormula docs
